name: ModelVariant432_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant432_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the French header-437 entry with 0x380-byte ribbons, a 192-unit sheet and a midpoint origin. The sheet, streamer and band helpers build from the French header-449 sources and the ribbon helper from model_variant/variant432_ribbons.c, all as matching C); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-449/599 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant449_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, binding it and its four helpers at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
